name: Coherent Grid Traversal
definition: A traversal algorithm that considers full slices of cells contained within a ray packet's bounding frustum, marching along a dominant axis, chosen for its ability to amortize voxel look-ups.
summary: Coherent Grid Traversal processes ray packets by incrementally computing frustum overlaps with grid slices, avoiding the cell-by-cell divergence issues of standard DDA traversal.
